default/30654.htm.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: Nice to meet you, young Warrior. I am Kiel Nighthawk of the Gryphon Knights. It is our duty to protect Giran Castle and its neighborhood from the green dragon, Antharas, and the creatures of Devil's Island.

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30654-01.html.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: Greetings, young Warrior. I am Kiel Nighthawk of the Griffon Knight union. Hannavalt sent word that you were coming. One of the virtues that define a Knight's character is a sense of justice . The history of this land of Dion is rife with gross injustice. One of the most heinous…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30654-02.html.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: As I said, you must kill the strains and the ghouls to collect the torn pieces of the report . When you gather all the pieces of Sir Talianus' report , bring it back to me. Got it?

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30654-03.html.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: Ah, the report that was to be presented to the King... Perhaps now we can release the spirits of Sir Talianus and his comrades from their torment... Take this Mirror of Orpic with you and go to the Execution Grounds. There is power dwelling in this mirror which enables you to se…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30654-04.html.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: You have not yet freed Spirit of Sir Talianus . The spirits of these brave soldiers must be put to rest. Go now to the Execution Grounds and destroy the hangman tree to free Sir Talianus from his torment.

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30654-05.html.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: Very interesting... It occurs to me that there must be some other reason why the spirits of Talianus and his men cannot rest in peace... I must do more research on this. You should now go and find Sir Isael Silvershadow in Hunter's Village to take the next part of the test.

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30654-06.html.text: Sir Kiel Nighthawk: You have given peace to the tortured souls of Sir Talianus and his men. You have passed this part of the trial admirably. For the next stage, you must seek out Sir Isael Silvershadow in the Hunter's Village .
